convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorHMA_StDev indicator (custom indicator with 6 buffers) and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh for position management, BuyPositionOpen/Close, SellPositionOpen/Close functions which encapsulate complex money management logic.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator warm-up

long.left: ColorHMA_StDev buffer 3 (buy dot) or buffer 5 (buy StDev dot)

short.left: ColorHMA_StDev buffer 2 (sell dot) or buffer 4 (sell StDev dot)

other_exits: Buy close on POINT mode: sell signal dots (buffer 2 or 4) appear; Buy close on DIRECT mode: HMA line[0] > HMA line[1] (line rising, which is opposite of sell signal)
Sell close on POINT mode: buy signal dots (buffer 3 or 5) appear; Sell close on DIRECT mode: HMA line[0] < HMA line[1] (line falling)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lots, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM parameter (0.1) interpreted based on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: Entry/exit signal modes are independently configurable per direction (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose) via SignalMode enum: POINT=signal dots from indicator buffers, DIRECT=HMA line direction change (crossover/crossunder of HMA values), WITHOUT=disabled. When SignalBar=0, signals are checked every tick instead of only on new bars. The DIRECT mode for buy open uses 3-bar HMA comparison (V-bottom: line[0]>line[1] && line[1]<line[2]) while sell open uses inverted V-top. DIRECT close modes use 2-bar comparison (line direction). SignalBar parameter defaults to 1 meaning signals are read from the previous completed bar.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorHMA_StDev custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python: it's a Hull Moving Average with standard deviation coloring and signal dots across 6 buffers. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionOpen, SellPositionClose functions with 5 margin modes that must be ported. The 6 indicator buffers map as: buffer 0=HMA line, buffer 1=unused/zero, buffer 2=sell color dots, buffer 3=buy color dots, buffer 4=sell StDev dots, buffer 5=buy StDev dots. The DIRECT mode V-bottom/V-top detection requires 3 consecutive HMA values. SignalBar=1 means use previous bar data (shift 1), not current bar.
